companion: harvest-weights-v2.json — the MEASURED per-cultivar sample log. v2 always wins over v3.
status: REFERENCE ESTIMATES — populated per Dave directive 2026-08-03 so harvest totals compute in grams now. Every value is an estimate; a measured sample for a (variety, unit) supersedes it.
tier_contract: Resolution order for an estimated harvest weight: (1) harvest logged in a weight unit (g/kg/lb/oz) = MEASURED, never estimated; (2) plant_varieties.unit_weights[unit]; (3) crop_types.unit_weights[unit]; (4) NULL = no estimate. Tiers 2-3 always set harvest_log.weight_estimated=true.

source_vocab.usda: USDA FoodData Central standard portion weight.
source_vocab.catalog: Seed-catalog stated fruit/head size for that named variety.
source_vocab.estimate: Typed best-guess from horticultural norms for the class; no per-variety source found.

confidence_vocab.high: Sourced value or a tight, well-documented range.
confidence_vocab.medium: Sourced class value applied to this variety, or a wide documented range.
confidence_vocab.low: Variety identity or type is uncertain — verify before trusting a total.
